abbott_smith_html:
ἔχω,
[in LXX for אָצֵל (ἐχόμενος), יֵשׁ,בַּעַל, etc., 59 words in all ;]
(on the Aktionsart of the various tenses, see M, Pr., 110, 145, 150, 183), to have, as in cl., in various senses and constructions.
__I. Trans.;
__1. 1. to have, hold, hold fast, etc.;
__(a) to hold, as, in the hand: Rev.5:8 14:6, al.; ἐν τ. χειρί, Rev.1:16 10:2, al.;
__(b) of arms and clothing, = φέρω, φορέω, to bear, wear: Mat.3:4 22:12, al.; so frequently present ptcp. (LS, see word, A, I, 6; Bl., 74, 2), Mrk.11:13, Jhn.18:10, Rev.9:17, al.;
__(with) of a woman, ἐν γαστρὶ ἔ, to be with child: Mrk.13:17, Rom.9:10;
__(d) to hold fast, keep: Luk.19:20; metaphorically, of the mind and conduct, Mrk.16:8 (cf. Job.21:6, Isa.13:8; Deiss., BS, 293; Field, Notes, 44f.), Jhn.14:21, Rom.1:28, 1Ti.3:9, 2Ti.1:13, Rev.6:9, al.;
__(e) to involve: Heb.10:35 (LXX), Jas.1:4, 1Jn.4:18; (f) = Lat. habere (Bl., §34, 5; 73, 5), to hold, consider: with accusative and predic. ptcp., Luk.14:18; with accusative, before ὡς, Mat.14:5; εἰς (Hebraism), Mat.21:46; on (Bl., §70, 2), Mrk.11:32.
__2. to have, possess;
__(a) in general, with accusative of thing(s): Mat.19:22, Mrk.10:22, Luk.12:19, Jhn.10:16, 1Co.11:22, al.; of wealth or poverty, absol., ἔχειν (neg. οὐκ, μή), Mat.13:12 25:29, 2Co.8:12; ἐκ τ. ἔχειν, according to your means, 2Co.8:11;
__(b) of relationship, association, and: πατέρα, Jhn.8:41; γυναῖκα (MM, xiv), 1Co.7:2; φίλον, Luk.11:5; βασιλέα, Jhn.19:15; ποιμένα, Mat.9:36; with dupl. accusative, Mat.3:9, al.;
__(with) of parts or members: ὦτα, Mat.19:15; μέλη, Rom.12:4; θεμελίους,
__(d) with accusative, as periphrasis of verb: μνεῖαν ἔ. (= μεμνῆσθαι), 1Th.3:6; ἀγάπην, Jhn.13:35; γνῶσιν, 1Co.8:1; πεποίθησιν, 2Co.3:4; θλίψιν, Jhn.16:33, etc. (Thayer, see word, I, 2, f., g.);
__(e) of duty, necessity, etc.: ἀνάγκην, 1Co.7:37; νόμον, Jhn.19:7; ἐπιταγήν, 1Co.7:25; ἀγῶνα, Php.1:30; κρίμα, 1Ti.5:12;
__(f) of complaints and disputes; κατά, with genitive of person(s), Mat.5:23, Mrk.11:25; id. before ὅτι, Rev.2:4, 20; with accusative before πρός, Act.24:19, al.;
__(g) with inf.,
__(α) (cl.) to be able (Field, Notes, 14): Mat.18:25, Mrk.14:8 (sc. ποιῆσαι), Luk.12:4, Act.4:14, al;
__(β) of necessity (BL, §69, 4): Luk.12:50, Act.23:17-19 28:19.
__II. Intrans. (BL, §53, 1), to be in a certain condition: ἑτοίμως ἔ., with inf., Act.21:13, 2Co.12:14; ἐσχάτως (which see), Mrk.5:23; κακῶς, to be ill, Mat.4:24, al.; καλῶς, Mk 16:[18]; κομψότερον, Jhn.4:52; πῶς, Act.15:36; impers., ἄλλως εἴχει, it is otherwise, 1Ti.5:25; οὕτως, Act.7:1, al.; τὸ νῦν ἔχον, as things now are (Tob.7:11), Act.24:25.
__III. Mid., -ομαι, to hold oneself fast, hold on or cling to, be next to: with genitive, τ. ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, Heb.6:9 (Rendall, in l.); ptcp., ὁ ἐχόμενος, near, next: of place, Mrk.1:38; of time, τ. ἐχομένη (ἡμέρα, expressed or understood), Luk.13:33, Act.20:15 21:26; (σαββάτῳ), Act.13:44. (Cf. ἀν-, προσ-αν-, ἀντ-, ἀπ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-, κατ-, μετ-, παρ-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπερ-, ὑπ-έχω.)
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
occurrences.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

occurrences.bsb: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

occurrences.bsb: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
occurrences.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

occurrences.bsb: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
occurrences.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

occurrences.bsb: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
occurrences.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

occurrences.bsb: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
occurrences.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

occurrences.bsb: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
occurrences.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

occurrences.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

occurrences.bsb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
occurrences.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
occurrences.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

occurrences.bsb: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
occurrences.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

occurrences.bsb: He who has ears, let him hear.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
occurrences.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

occurrences.bsb: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

occurrences.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

occurrences.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

occurrences.bsb: He who has ears, let him hear.”
occurrences.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

occurrences.bsb: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
occurrences.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

occurrences.bsb: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
occurrences.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

occurrences.bsb: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

occurrences.bsb: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
occurrences.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

occurrences.bsb: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
occurrences.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

occurrences.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

occurrences.bsb: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

occurrences.bsb: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
occurrences.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

occurrences.bsb: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet, and He healed them.
occurrences.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:

occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

occurrences.bsb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

occurrences.bsb: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

occurrences.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

occurrences.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

occurrences.bsb: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
occurrences.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

occurrences.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

occurrences.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

occurrences.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

occurrences.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

occurrences.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

occurrences.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

occurrences.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

occurrences.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

occurrences.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

occurrences.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

occurrences.bsb: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
occurrences.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

occurrences.bsb: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
occurrences.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

occurrences.bsb: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
occurrences.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

occurrences.bsb: “Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them. And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
occurrences.kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

occurrences.bsb: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.
occurrences.kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.
occurrences.kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

occurrences.bsb: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
occurrences.kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

occurrences.bsb: “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
occurrences.kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

occurrences.bsb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
occurrences.kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

occurrences.bsb: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
occurrences.kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

occurrences.bsb: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
occurrences.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

occurrences.bsb: So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
occurrences.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

occurrences.bsb: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
occurrences.kjv: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

occurrences.bsb: ‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?
occurrences.kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

occurrences.bsb: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
occurrences.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

occurrences.bsb: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

occurrences.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
occurrences.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
occurrences.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

occurrences.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
occurrences.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

occurrences.bsb: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

occurrences.bsb: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.”
occurrences.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
occurrences.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
occurrences.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

occurrences.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
occurrences.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

occurrences.bsb: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
occurrences.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

occurrences.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
occurrences.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
occurrences.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

occurrences.bsb: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
occurrences.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

occurrences.bsb: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
occurrences.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

occurrences.bsb: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “Why do we need any more witnesses?
occurrences.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

occurrences.bsb: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
occurrences.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

occurrences.bsb: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”
occurrences.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

occurrences.bsb: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
occurrences.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

occurrences.bsb: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.
occurrences.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

occurrences.bsb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins…” He said to the paralytic, “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
occurrences.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus knew their thoughts and said to the man with the withered hand, “Get up and stand among us.” So he got up and stood there.
occurrences.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

occurrences.bsb: There a highly valued servant of a centurion was sick and about to die.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

occurrences.bsb: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
occurrences.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

occurrences.bsb: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’
occurrences.kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, Teacher,” he said.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

occurrences.bsb: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Which one, then, will love him more?”
occurrences.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

occurrences.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
occurrences.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

occurrences.bsb: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprang up and produced a crop—a hundredfold.” As Jesus said this, He called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
occurrences.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
occurrences.kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

occurrences.bsb: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.”
occurrences.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus stepped ashore, He was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothing or lived in a house, but he stayed in the tombs.
occurrences.kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

occurrences.bsb: “Take nothing for the journey,” He told them, “no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

occurrences.bsb: But the crowds found out and followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and He healed those who needed healing.
occurrences.kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

occurrences.bsb: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
occurrences.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

occurrences.bsb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
occurrences.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
occurrences.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

occurrences.bsb: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
occurrences.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

occurrences.bsb: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
occurrences.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

occurrences.bsb: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
occurrences.kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

occurrences.bsb: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
occurrences.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.
occurrences.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

occurrences.bsb: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

occurrences.bsb: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’
occurrences.kjv: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

occurrences.bsb: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
occurrences.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

occurrences.bsb: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
occurrences.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

occurrences.bsb: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
occurrences.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
occurrences.kjv: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

occurrences.bsb: I tell you that in the same way there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
occurrences.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

occurrences.bsb: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
occurrences.kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
occurrences.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

occurrences.bsb: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
occurrences.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

occurrences.bsb: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’
occurrences.kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

occurrences.bsb: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
occurrences.kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

occurrences.bsb: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
occurrences.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
occurrences.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

occurrences.bsb: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
occurrences.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

occurrences.bsb: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
occurrences.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

occurrences.bsb: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
occurrences.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

occurrences.bsb: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

occurrences.bsb: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cesar’s.

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.bsb: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

occurrences.bsb: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
occurrences.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

occurrences.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
occurrences.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

occurrences.bsb: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
occurrences.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

occurrences.bsb: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
occurrences.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

occurrences.bsb: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

occurrences.bsb: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
occurrences.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

occurrences.bsb: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
occurrences.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

occurrences.bsb: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
occurrences.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

occurrences.bsb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
occurrences.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

occurrences.bsb: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

occurrences.bsb: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
occurrences.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

occurrences.bsb: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
occurrences.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

occurrences.bsb: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

occurrences.bsb: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
occurrences.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

occurrences.bsb: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.”
occurrences.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

occurrences.bsb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
occurrences.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

occurrences.bsb: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
occurrences.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

occurrences.bsb: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
occurrences.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

occurrences.bsb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

occurrences.bsb: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
occurrences.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

occurrences.bsb: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
occurrences.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

occurrences.bsb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
occurrences.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

occurrences.bsb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
occurrences.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

occurrences.bsb: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
occurrences.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

occurrences.bsb: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
occurrences.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
occurrences.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
occurrences.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

occurrences.bsb: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
occurrences.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

occurrences.bsb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
occurrences.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

occurrences.bsb: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
occurrences.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

occurrences.bsb: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

occurrences.bsb: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
occurrences.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

occurrences.bsb: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

occurrences.bsb: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
occurrences.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

occurrences.bsb: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

occurrences.bsb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

occurrences.bsb: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
occurrences.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

occurrences.bsb: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
occurrences.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

occurrences.bsb: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
occurrences.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

occurrences.bsb: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”
occurrences.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.
occurrences.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

occurrences.bsb: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
occurrences.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

occurrences.bsb: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”
occurrences.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

occurrences.bsb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.
occurrences.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

occurrences.bsb: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
occurrences.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

occurrences.bsb: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

occurrences.bsb: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
occurrences.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

occurrences.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
occurrences.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
occurrences.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

occurrences.bsb: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
occurrences.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

occurrences.bsb: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
occurrences.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

occurrences.bsb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
occurrences.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

occurrences.bsb: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
occurrences.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

occurrences.bsb: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
occurrences.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

occurrences.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
occurrences.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

occurrences.bsb: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
occurrences.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

occurrences.bsb: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
occurrences.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

occurrences.bsb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
occurrences.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

occurrences.bsb: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
occurrences.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

occurrences.bsb: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
occurrences.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

occurrences.bsb: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
occurrences.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

occurrences.bsb: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
occurrences.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

occurrences.bsb: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
occurrences.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

occurrences.bsb: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
occurrences.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
occurrences.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

occurrences.bsb: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

occurrences.bsb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
occurrences.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.

occurrences.bsb: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
occurrences.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

occurrences.bsb: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
occurrences.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

occurrences.bsb: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
occurrences.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

occurrences.bsb: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them, they had nothing to say in response.
occurrences.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

occurrences.bsb: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as he had need.
occurrences.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

occurrences.bsb: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

occurrences.bsb: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
occurrences.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

occurrences.bsb: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
occurrences.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

occurrences.bsb: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

occurrences.bsb: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

occurrences.bsb: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

occurrences.bsb: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
occurrences.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

occurrences.bsb: This man was listening to the words of Paul, who looked intently at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.
occurrences.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

occurrences.bsb: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

occurrences.bsb: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
occurrences.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

occurrences.bsb: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, who earned a large income for her masters by fortune-telling.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

occurrences.bsb: Now the Bereans were more noble-minded than the Thessalonians, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true.
occurrences.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

occurrences.bsb: Paul remained in Corinth for quite some time before saying goodbye to the brothers. He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila.
occurrences.kjv: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were some itinerant Jewish exorcists who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those with evil spirits. They would say, “I command you by Jesus, whom Paul proclaims.”
occurrences.kjv: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

occurrences.bsb: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open and proconsuls are available. Let them bring charges against one another there.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

occurrences.bsb: Sailing on from there, we arrived the next day opposite Chios. The day after that we arrived at Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.
occurrences.kjv: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
occurrences.kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

occurrences.kjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, “Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.

occurrences.bsb: So the centurion took him to the commander and said, “Paul the prisoner sent and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
occurrences.kjv: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.

occurrences.bsb: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside, and asked, “What do you need to tell me?”
occurrences.kjv: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?

occurrences.bsb: And he wrote the following letter:
occurrences.kjv: And he wrote a letter after this manner:

occurrences.bsb: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
occurrences.kjv: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews concurred, asserting that these charges were true.
occurrences.kjv: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.

occurrences.bsb: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
occurrences.kjv: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

occurrences.bsb: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
occurrences.kjv: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.

occurrences.bsb: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
occurrences.kjv: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

occurrences.kjv: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

occurrences.bsb: As Paul expounded on righteousness, self-control, and the coming judgment, Felix became frightened and said, “You may go for now. When I find the time, I will call for you.”
occurrences.kjv: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

occurrences.bsb: I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand a man over before he has had an opportunity to face his accusers and defend himself against their charges.
occurrences.kjv: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

occurrences.bsb: They only had some contentions with him regarding their own religion and a certain Jesus who had died, but whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
occurrences.kjv: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

occurrences.bsb: I have nothing definite to write to our sovereign about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this inquiry I may have something to write.
occurrences.kjv: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

occurrences.bsb: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they sighted a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.
occurrences.kjv: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

occurrences.bsb: After this had happened, the rest of the sick on the island came and were cured as well.
occurrences.kjv: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

occurrences.bsb: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar, even though I have no charge to bring against my nation.
occurrences.kjv: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now), in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.
occurrences.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
occurrences.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
occurrences.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

occurrences.bsb: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—
occurrences.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

occurrences.bsb: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.
occurrences.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
occurrences.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

occurrences.bsb: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

occurrences.bsb: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
occurrences.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

occurrences.bsb: Not only that, but Rebecca’s children were conceived by one man, our father Isaac.
occurrences.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

occurrences.bsb: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
occurrences.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

occurrences.bsb: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.
occurrences.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

occurrences.bsb: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
