occurrences.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

occurrences.bsb: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
occurrences.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

occurrences.bsb: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
occurrences.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

occurrences.bsb: Keep your belief about such matters between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
occurrences.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

occurrences.bsb: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
occurrences.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
occurrences.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

occurrences.bsb: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to visit you,
occurrences.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

occurrences.bsb: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
occurrences.kjv: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

occurrences.bsb: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
occurrences.kjv: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father’s wife.

occurrences.bsb: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
occurrences.kjv: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

occurrences.bsb: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
occurrences.kjv: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

occurrences.bsb: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;
occurrences.kjv: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?

occurrences.bsb: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
occurrences.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.

occurrences.bsb: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
occurrences.kjv: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

occurrences.bsb: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

occurrences.bsb: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

occurrences.bsb: But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
occurrences.kjv: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
occurrences.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

occurrences.bsb: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.

occurrences.bsb: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
occurrences.kjv: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

occurrences.bsb: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
occurrences.kjv: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

occurrences.bsb: Have we no right to food and to drink?
occurrences.kjv: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

occurrences.bsb: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
occurrences.kjv: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

occurrences.bsb: Or are Barnabas and I the only apostles who must work for a living?
occurrences.kjv: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

occurrences.bsb: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.
occurrences.kjv: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
occurrences.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

occurrences.bsb: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!
occurrences.kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
occurrences.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

occurrences.bsb: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
occurrences.kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

occurrences.bsb: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
occurrences.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

occurrences.bsb: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
occurrences.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

occurrences.bsb: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
occurrences.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

occurrences.bsb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

occurrences.bsb: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

occurrences.bsb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
occurrences.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

occurrences.bsb: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

occurrences.bsb: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
occurrences.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
occurrences.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

occurrences.bsb: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
occurrences.kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

occurrences.bsb: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be grieved by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
occurrences.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

occurrences.bsb: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.
occurrences.kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

occurrences.bsb: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
occurrences.kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

occurrences.bsb: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
occurrences.kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

occurrences.bsb: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
occurrences.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

occurrences.bsb: And in keeping with what is written, “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
occurrences.kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

occurrences.bsb: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

occurrences.bsb: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
occurrences.kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

occurrences.bsb: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
occurrences.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
occurrences.kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

occurrences.bsb: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
occurrences.kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

occurrences.bsb: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

occurrences.bsb: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
occurrences.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

occurrences.bsb: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
occurrences.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

occurrences.bsb: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
occurrences.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
occurrences.kjv: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

occurrences.bsb: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

occurrences.bsb: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
occurrences.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

occurrences.bsb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

occurrences.bsb: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

occurrences.bsb: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
occurrences.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
occurrences.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

occurrences.bsb: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
occurrences.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

occurrences.bsb: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
occurrences.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

occurrences.bsb: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

occurrences.bsb: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
occurrences.kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

occurrences.bsb: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
occurrences.kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

occurrences.bsb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
occurrences.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

occurrences.bsb: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
occurrences.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

occurrences.bsb: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
occurrences.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

occurrences.bsb: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
occurrences.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

occurrences.bsb: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
occurrences.kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

occurrences.bsb: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
occurrences.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

occurrences.bsb: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
occurrences.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

occurrences.bsb: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
occurrences.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

occurrences.bsb: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
occurrences.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

occurrences.bsb: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
occurrences.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

occurrences.bsb: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
occurrences.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

occurrences.bsb: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

occurrences.bsb: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
occurrences.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

occurrences.bsb: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
occurrences.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

occurrences.bsb: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
occurrences.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

occurrences.bsb: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
occurrences.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
occurrences.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

occurrences.bsb: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
occurrences.kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

occurrences.bsb: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
occurrences.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

occurrences.bsb: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
occurrences.kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

occurrences.bsb: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
occurrences.kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

occurrences.bsb: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
occurrences.kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

occurrences.bsb: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
occurrences.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

occurrences.bsb: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
occurrences.kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

occurrences.bsb: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
occurrences.kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

occurrences.bsb: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
occurrences.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

occurrences.bsb: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
occurrences.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

occurrences.bsb: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
occurrences.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

occurrences.bsb: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
occurrences.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

occurrences.bsb: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
occurrences.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

occurrences.bsb: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
occurrences.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

occurrences.bsb: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

occurrences.bsb: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
occurrences.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

occurrences.bsb: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
occurrences.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

occurrences.bsb: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

occurrences.bsb: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
occurrences.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

occurrences.bsb: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
occurrences.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

occurrences.bsb: He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
occurrences.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

occurrences.bsb: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
occurrences.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
occurrences.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
occurrences.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

occurrences.bsb: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

occurrences.bsb: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

occurrences.bsb: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

occurrences.bsb: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
occurrences.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

occurrences.bsb: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

occurrences.bsb: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
occurrences.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
occurrences.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

occurrences.bsb: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
occurrences.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

occurrences.bsb: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
occurrences.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

occurrences.bsb: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
occurrences.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

occurrences.bsb: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

occurrences.bsb: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
occurrences.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

occurrences.bsb: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
occurrences.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

occurrences.bsb: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
occurrences.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

occurrences.bsb: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
occurrences.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

occurrences.bsb: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

occurrences.bsb: But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
occurrences.kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

occurrences.bsb: But because Jesus lives forever, He has a permanent priesthood.
occurrences.kjv: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

occurrences.bsb: Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.
occurrences.kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

occurrences.bsb: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
occurrences.kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

occurrences.bsb: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
occurrences.kjv: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

occurrences.bsb: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
occurrences.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

occurrences.bsb: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
occurrences.kjv: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

occurrences.bsb: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
occurrences.kjv: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

occurrences.bsb: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.
occurrences.kjv: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

occurrences.bsb: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
occurrences.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

occurrences.bsb: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
occurrences.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

occurrences.bsb: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
occurrences.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

occurrences.bsb: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
occurrences.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

occurrences.bsb: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
occurrences.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

occurrences.bsb: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
occurrences.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

occurrences.bsb: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
occurrences.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

occurrences.bsb: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
occurrences.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

occurrences.bsb: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
occurrences.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

occurrences.bsb: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
occurrences.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

occurrences.bsb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
occurrences.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

occurrences.bsb: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
occurrences.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

occurrences.bsb: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
occurrences.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

occurrences.bsb: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
occurrences.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

occurrences.bsb: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.

occurrences.bsb: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

occurrences.bsb: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
occurrences.kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

occurrences.bsb: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
occurrences.kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

occurrences.bsb: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
occurrences.kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

occurrences.bsb: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

occurrences.bsb: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
occurrences.kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

occurrences.bsb: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

occurrences.bsb: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
occurrences.kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

occurrences.bsb: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
occurrences.kjv: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

occurrences.bsb: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
occurrences.kjv: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

occurrences.bsb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
occurrences.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

occurrences.bsb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
occurrences.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

occurrences.bsb: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
occurrences.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

occurrences.bsb: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
occurrences.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
occurrences.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
occurrences.kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

occurrences.bsb: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
occurrences.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

occurrences.bsb: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
occurrences.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

occurrences.bsb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
occurrences.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

occurrences.bsb: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
occurrences.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

occurrences.bsb: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

occurrences.bsb: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
occurrences.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

occurrences.bsb: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
occurrences.kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
occurrences.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

occurrences.bsb: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
occurrences.kjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

occurrences.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
occurrences.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

occurrences.bsb: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
occurrences.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

occurrences.bsb: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
occurrences.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

occurrences.bsb: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
occurrences.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

occurrences.bsb: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

occurrences.bsb: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
occurrences.kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

occurrences.bsb: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
occurrences.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

occurrences.bsb: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
occurrences.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

occurrences.bsb: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
occurrences.kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
occurrences.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

occurrences.bsb: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

occurrences.bsb: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
occurrences.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

occurrences.bsb: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you
occurrences.kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

occurrences.bsb: than to hold fast to what you have until I come.
occurrences.kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

occurrences.bsb: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

occurrences.bsb: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

occurrences.bsb: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
occurrences.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

occurrences.bsb: I know your deeds. Behold, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
occurrences.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

occurrences.bsb: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

occurrences.bsb: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
occurrences.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

occurrences.bsb: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
occurrences.kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

occurrences.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

occurrences.bsb: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

occurrences.bsb: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

occurrences.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

occurrences.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

occurrences.bsb: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
occurrences.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

occurrences.bsb: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
occurrences.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

occurrences.bsb: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
occurrences.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

occurrences.bsb: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
occurrences.kjv: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

occurrences.bsb: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

occurrences.bsb: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
occurrences.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

occurrences.bsb: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
occurrences.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

occurrences.bsb: They also had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
occurrences.kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

occurrences.bsb: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
occurrences.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

occurrences.bsb: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.
occurrences.kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.

occurrences.bsb: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

occurrences.bsb: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
occurrences.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

occurrences.bsb: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
occurrences.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

occurrences.bsb: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
occurrences.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
occurrences.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

occurrences.bsb: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
occurrences.kjv: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

occurrences.bsb: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
occurrences.kjv: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

occurrences.bsb: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

occurrences.bsb: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
occurrences.kjv: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear:
occurrences.kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

occurrences.bsb: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
occurrences.kjv: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

occurrences.bsb: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
occurrences.kjv: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

occurrences.bsb: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
occurrences.kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

occurrences.bsb: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
